project.name: SFS Reconstruction Engine
project.description: Reconstruction Engine subsystem : the request manager and job state machine, the DNA and rule loader, planner integration, model execution, constraint checking, post-processing and TXT artifact generation. Coordinates end-to-end semantic reconstruction from the Memory DB through model contract and produces a new, labeled TXT artifact. Original bytes are never required; protected references are refused before any reconstruction runs; jobs are immutable and auditable.
